findings.evidence: F2 claims for every real α that (ℏ²/2m)A_α has ψ_α as an eigenvector with eigenvalue −ℏ²α²/(8m), without restricting this eigenpair claim to α<0. The current source theorem thm-nrqm-intervals-delta-unique-bound-state defines this normalized bound state and proves its eigenvalue only for α<0; for α≥0 it states there is no negative eigenvalue. The batch-51 proof uses the scaled eigenpair only for g<0, so its conclusions remain supported, but the extra fact in F2 is false or undefined outside that range. Restrict the scaled eigenvector clause to α<0.
